gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-lexend-zetta: Relaxed and inviting, Delius Unicase handwrites its headings with a pronounced x-height. Lexend Zetta is the steadier one, a sans-serif with widely tracked, ribbon-flat strokes that stay approachable and keep the text moving.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-liter: Liter sets down flat, stroke-contrast-free lines with tall lowercase. Delius Unicase is the hand-drawn voice, loose and friendly up top, while Liter keeps the body plain sans and its wide-mouthed rounds easy to follow.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-mada: Soft hand-lettering meets towering lowercase. And Mada, a sans with curves that refuse to close, gives Delius Unicase's unhurried, untapered strokes a body that feels approachable and modern beside them.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-martel-sans: Delius Unicase has stout, untapered strokes, like bent pipe cleaners. Martel Sans follows in a plain sans with generous curve openings and a high mean line, so the hand-drawn warmth up top settles into tidy text.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-matangi: Matangi reads like a sturdy sans, hefty in the lowercase, with strokes pressed flat like twine and rounded letters left open. Over a long passage it feels modern and unfussy.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro reads as a modern sans-serif with a high-waisted lowercase, its c opening wide and its line thickness hardly shifting. Across a longer stretch it stays quiet and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable from the first line, Delius Unicase hand-draws its headings with a relaxed, untapered stroke. But Miriam Libre, a sans-serif with wire-like weight and a stately lowercase, anchors the text below it.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Delius Unicase brings a relaxed, handwritten feel with untapered strokes and a pronounced x-height. And Mochiy Pop One, a sans with a very large lowercase, answers in laser-cut single-width lines, so a modest heading size should be plenty.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-mochiy-pop-p-on: Mochiy Pop P One reads wide and sizable, its letters set well apart. Delius Unicase supplies a hand-drawn, relaxed heading above it, and the sans-serif body keeps every stroke smooth and clean.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-montserrat-alte: Montserrat Alternates reads as a contemporary sans-serif, its lowercase pressing up toward the capital line. Montserrat Alternates is the crisper of the two, while Delius Unicase does what it does best: a loose, handwritten, untapered warmth.
